learning_outcomes.text: Explain the .NET memory model and garbage collection generations
Identify costly allocation patterns including the Large Object Heap
Reduce allocations with Span, pooling and value types
Diagnose memory and performance issues with .NET tools
Manage resource lifetime with IDisposable and client reuse

integrative_case: Investigate a .NET service with rising memory and latency: measure allocations, identify a large-object hot path driving Gen 2 collections, reduce garbage with pooling, confirm the fix with a trace, and correct an HttpClient-per-request pattern that is leaking sockets.
